newsitem.title: POLAND: Exbud pays PLN 7 mln for construction firm.
newsitem.headline: Exbud pays PLN 7 mln for construction firm.

text.p: Polish construction firm Exbud SA paid seven million zlotys for a 73.1-percent stake in construction firm Poznanskie Przedsiebiorstwo Budownictwa Przemyslowego Jedynka Poznan SA, Exbud said on Monday in a statement.
The company did not say from whom it bought the stake of 600,000 shares and no-one in the firm was available for comment.
It said the remaining shares in the purchased firm belonged to individual shareholders, mainly to the firm's employees.
It said the company, based in the western city of Poznan, employed 800 people, but did not give any other details.
